en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large Renaissance / Baroque town hall dominating a market square. The building has a steep gabled roof with multiple stepped gables, dormer-like upper windows, a small turret with a spire in the center, and elaborate window framing. A columned balcony/portal marks the main entrance reached by stairs. In the foreground are townspeople in early-20th‑century clothing, a kiosk or advertising column, small market stalls, and a horse-drawn carriage. Shops line the ground floor of adjacent buildings around the square.
